question_text: A 58-year-old man reported a history of 3 weeks of evolution with progressive, moderately painful skin lesions on his left arm. It had started as an erythematous lesion on his left thumb. It had reddish streaks visible as connecting lines between the lesions. The patient did not present fever or other general symptoms. He had been working in his garden but could not remember having any injuries. The etiological diagnosis was made by culture of a skin biopsy. What is the most likely causative agent of this process?
